articles.title: Supreme Court Clears the Way for Mail Ballots Ahead of Midterms
articles.summary: The Supreme Court rejected Trump's plan to let the Postal Service decide who gets mail ballots. Election officials can now send ballots as planned, easing fears of chaos before the midterms.

articles.title: China's Diplomatic Balancing Act: Can It Mediate Between Iran and the U.S.?
articles.summary: Iran's foreign minister visits Beijing on Wednesday as China tries to position itself as a neutral peacemaker. But experts doubt whether China will truly mediate between Iran and the U.S.

articles.title: Senate Crypto Vote Tests Trump's Financial Entanglements
articles.summary: The Senate votes Tuesday on a crypto regulation bill, a pivotal test two months before the midterms. Democrats demand ethics safeguards to stop Trump from profiting; Republicans say the bill protects consumers.
